title: helictochloa albinervis
intro: Helictochloa albinervis, commonly known as Mountain Bent, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can help in soothing digestive issues and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Helictochloa albinervis include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
